Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-18T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Acme POC - Environment setup dependencies (VPC, SSO, IP allowlists, KMS)

Thanks for the time today \u0014 appreciate the open discussion on scope and success criteria for the Acme POC. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on milestones for the environment setup. High-level asks from the call: VPC peering, IP allowlists, SSO/SAML integration, and secrets/KMS access.

Quick recap and next steps we agreed on:
- Customer\u0012Redwood: Provide VPC CIDRs and network contact for peering (Bob) \u0014 target: 7/22
- Redwood (Nikhil)\u0012Customer: Provide peering template and test plan \u0014 target: 7/24
- Customer\u0012Redwood: Confirm SAML metadata URL and IdP contact \u0014 target: 7/21
- Redwood (Dev)\u0012Customer: Confirm KMS/secrets integration options and required IAM roles \u0014 target: 7/26
- Joint: Finalize MAP and lock POC start date (target 8/03)

Milestone: POC environment ready for smoke tests (dependencies):
1) VPC peering established (Acme network team + Redwood infra) \u0014 responsibility: Acme (Bob) / Redwood (Nikhil) \u0014 target complete: 7/24
2) IP allowlist entries configured (both control plane and worker ranges) \u0014 responsibility: Acme (network) / Redwood infra \u0014 target: 7/24
3) SSO/SAML configured (test users & metadata exchange) \u0014 responsibility: Acme (IdP) / Redwood (Engineers) \u0014 target: 7/21
4) Secrets/KMS access & key wrapping (if customer-managed) or temporary secret exchange \u0014 responsibility: Redwood (Dev) / Acme security \u0014 target: 7/26

Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.pdf (first draft of milestones and responsibilities). Please review and call out any missing dependencies. If these dates work, I'll update the MAP and send a version for your sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0199

Date: 2026-07-19T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Acme POC - Environment setup dependencies (VPC, SSO, IP allowlists, KMS)

Thanks Marissa \u0014 good recap and appreciate the organized MAP. A couple of clarifying Qs from our infra/security side before we lock dates:
1) VPC peering: we can do VPC peering but need your expected VPC CIDR ranges and any preferred AWS account IDs. I've attached our network diagram.
2) IP allowlists: please confirm the exact egress IP ranges Redwood will use for control-plane callbacks so our firewall team can add rules.
3) SSO/SAML: we use Okta. Will you need a metadata file or a metadata URL? Our IdP team prefers a metadata URL but can provide an XML file.
4) KMS/secrets: our security team prefers customer-managed CMK for production, but for a POC we can use scoped temporary keys. We need to know what permissions you require and any KMS CMK ARNs if we go that route.

I'll loop Bob and our IdP/security owners on the follow-ups. Tentatively we can hit the SAML milestone by 7/21 if we exchange metadata today.

\u0014 Alice
Alice Johnson
Product Security Manager | Acme Corp
alice.johnson@acme.com

--

Subject: Internal: Action items for Acme POC MAP - VPC/SSO/KMS

Team \u0014 forwarding Acme's note. Please confirm owners and any missing asks so I can update the MAP and send back to Acme. Suggested assignment:
- VPC peering & IP allowlist details: Nikhil (owner) \u0014 prepare peering template + expected Redwood VPC CIDRs and AWS account IDs
- SSO/SAML integration: Rachel (owner) \u0014 confirm if Redwood needs metadata URL or XML; provide Okta setup doc and test user steps
- KMS/secrets + IAM perms: Dev (owner) \u0014 outline options for POC (temporary scoped keys) vs. customer-managed CMK and list required IAM roles/policies

Please reply with confirmed target dates. The customer wants SAML done by 7/21 and peering by 7/24 \u0014 both are doable but we should call out any blockers now (e.g., support for customer-managed CMK requires extra compliance sign-off).

Thanks \u0014 I'll update the MAP after your replies and resend to Acme for sign-off.

Marissa

Marissa / team,

Thanks \u0014 confirmed I'll take point on peering and IP ranges. Quick questions / notes:
- Redwood VPC CIDRs for POC: 10.20.0.0/16 (control plane) and 10.30.0.0/16 (workers). We can also provide specific egress IP ranges for firewall rules once the peering is in place \u0014 estimate those ranges by 7/22.
- AWS account IDs: 123456789012 (redwood-poc). If Acme needs a peering template, I'll send a CloudFormation snippet and a brief test plan by end of day 7/21.
- SAML: Rachel, if you can confirm whether we prefer metadata URL or XML. We can consume either but metadata URL is easier for automated exchanges.
- KMS: Dev \u0014 FYI, if Acme requests CMK usage we need a short security checklist; otherwise for POC we can use a Redwood-managed transient key and follow our temporary secret exchange flow.

Target timeline (tentative):
- SAML metadata exchange: 2026-07-21 (Rachel to confirm)
- Peering & IP allowlists applied: 2026-07-24
- KMS decision & temp key setup: 2026-07-26

I'll send the peering template and expected egress ranges (small list) by tomorrow.

Cheers,
Nikhil Sharma

Thanks everyone \u0014 validated timeline with our network and security teams. Confirming:
- We'll provide VPC CIDRs and the peering contact (Bob) by EOD 7/22.
- Our IdP (Okta) team will publish a metadata URL today; we will send the URL to Rachel.
- Security is OK with Redwood-managed temporary keys for the POC; we'll re-evaluate CMK for any production rollout.

With those items, we should be able to meet the targeted POC start of 8/03. Please send the updated MAP (v2) with the assigned owners and dates and I'll circulate to procurement/security for sign-off.
